typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		DatabaseId as integer,
		DatabaseTypeId as integer,
		DatabaseName as string,
		ServerName as string,
		UserId as string,
		Pswd as string,
		DatabaseProviderId as integer,
		ConnectionString as string,
		SendToTrackerFlag as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'Set identity_insert [Shared].[Databases] on;  select    DatabaseId=0 		   ,[DatabaseTypeId]=1            ,[DatabaseName]=Cast(\'DuckCreek\' as nvarchar(25))            ,[ServerName]=Cast(\'DuckCreek\' as varchar(25))            ,[UserId]=Cast(\'DuckCreek\' as varchar(25))            ,[Pswd]=Cast(\'DuckCreek\' as varchar(25))            ,[DatabaseProviderId]=1            ,[ConnectionString]=Cast(\'DuckCreek\' as nvarchar(25))                   ,[SendToTrackerFlag]=0',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource	source(output(
		DatabaseId as integer,
		DatabaseTypeId as integer,
		DatabaseName as string,
		ServerName as string,
		UserId as string,
		Pswd as string,
		DatabaseProviderId as integer,
		ConnectionString as string,
		DBExecStatus as boolean,
		Id as string,
		Deleted as integer,
		SendToTrackerFlag as boolean
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select * from Shared.Databases',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
OLEDBSource,LookupLKPTABLE lookup(OLEDBSource@DatabaseId == LookupLKPTABLE@DatabaseId,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup select(mapColumn(
		DatabaseId = OLEDBSource@DatabaseId,
		DatabaseTypeId = OLEDBSource@DatabaseTypeId,
		DatabaseName = OLEDBSource@DatabaseName,
		ServerName = OLEDBSource@ServerName,
		UserId = OLEDBSource@UserId,
		Pswd = OLEDBSource@Pswd,
		DatabaseProviderId = OLEDBSource@DatabaseProviderId,
		ConnectionString = OLEDBSource@ConnectionString,
		SendToTrackerFlag = OLEDBSource@SendToTrackerFlag,
		DBExecStatus = DBExecStatus,
		Id = Id,
		Deleted = Deleted
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Lookup01
Lookup01 filter(!isMatch()) ~> Lookup0
Lookup0 sink(input(
		DatabaseTypeId as integer,
		UserId as string,
		Pswd as string,
		ServerName as string,
		DatabaseName as string,
		DatabaseId as integer,
		ConnectionString as string,
		SendToTrackerFlag as boolean,
		DatabaseProviderId as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		DatabaseTypeId,
		UserId,
		Pswd,
		ServerName,
		DatabaseName,
		DatabaseId,
		ConnectionString,
		SendToTrackerFlag,
		DatabaseProviderId)) ~> OLEDBDestination
